def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a relative file name with no separators or parent references."""
    ex is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../secret.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if name.contains("/") or name.contains("\\") or name.contains(".."):
        return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the text of file `name` inside the directory `notes`.

    Reads only through `fs` narrowed to `notes`, so no name, including
    absolute paths or ones containing `..`, reaches a file outside `notes`.
    A missing or unreadable file yields the empty string.
    """
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return fs.read_text(name) else ""
